products.body_html:
Feel the difference of a lightweight wheelchair from a leading name in personal mobility.

The Roma 1500 is a self-propelled wheelchair made using ultra lightweight aluminium tubing, making it much lighter than equivalent manual wheelchairs made from steel. Despite this, the Roma 1500 can support users up to 18 stone in safety and comfort.
